audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows contradicted the page's own prose. The chart gave Riven levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items and called levels 4-5 and 6 'Skill', while whys[1] says your stun arrives before her Q chain, whys[2] says bully her off the wave freely, whys[3] says force your W the moment Ki Burst is down, whys[4] says 'she simply cannot kill you in this window', and whys[5] says your stun still beats her shield.
audit.why: Renekton wins 54.36% here and the reason is on the page already: Riven's damage requires an uninterrupted combo and Renekton's W is point-and-click. The packet chart and the whys agree with each other; only the win[] and phases[].side rows disagreed with both.
audit.corrected: Skill, Renekton, Renekton, Renekton, Renekton, Renekton, Skill in both layers as one atomic group, ratings raised on the rows that changed hands.

audit.why: The four spikes are right and specific: your level-2 pattern, Dominus at 6, your first item, and her Black Cleaver / Death's Dance two-item recovery. Blade of the Exile drops to 60s at rank 3, which is why late fights are repeatable for her in a way lane fights are not.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Valor's shield as something that simply absorbs your burst ('her shield absorbs your Q burst', 'Use E shield to absorb your empowered Q burst'). Above 50 Fury, Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on the target — it deletes that block rather than being eaten by it. Riven's Q was also called a 'Q3-knockup' when Riot's text says the third hit knocks back, and its flat 13s cooldown appeared nowhere.
audit.why: Renekton W: 'he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target'. Riven E: 'Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage', 10s at rank 1. Riven Q: 'reactivated three times... with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies', 13s flat. The shield clause is the reason a full-Fury all-in beats her, and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Shield destruction now stated in the do's, in Key Ability Interactions and in what she wants; the Q knockback is described correctly with its flat 13s cooldown.

edits.after: All three online: your second E exits before her third Q knocks back, and Q is a flat 13s so a spent chain is a free window.

edits.after: Use Valor's shield to absorb your burst — but an empowered W above 50 Fury destroys it
